title: Mission buildings (our own): whole buildings with their interiors -- police, fire, hospital, office, resort hotel, warehouse yard, the military base, the airport terminal and hangar, a cargo ship, safe houses (residential and downtown), an izakaya, a maid cafe, an adult-services building, banks, a car park, the civil control tower, a fashion building and a department store, a civic centre, an onsen ryokan and a high-security estate -- one .blend per building
author: this project
notes: One .blend per building (Koban.blend, PoliceStation.blend, ...); each OWNS its piece <Id>: the whole building (shell, floors, stairs, lift shafts, rooms, fittings). blender/tools/build_interior_blends.py laid them out once from blender/tools/interior_plans.py and keeps a piece an artist has edited.

The piece is a building_types.json `custom` row (kit interiors): a trimesh collider of its mesh, its EXIT_ Empties the outer doors, DOOR_ the interior doors, LIFT_ the lifts (world.Elevator, several stops), MARK_ the mission markers (a `Markers` node of Marker3Ds in group mission_marker).
Materials are the central library's palette: the scene builder resolves every surface to kits/library/materials/<name>.tres (materials_from).
